prompt:
Generate a NEW realistic ten-second single continuous video shot from this exact opening photograph, vertical 9:16, 720p. The exact adult bicycle helmet in reference image 1: matte charcoal-black sculpted shell, broad curved projecting front visor, long angular ventilation openings and dark mesh beneath, black Y-shaped chin straps and small black buckle. Preserve the silhouette, vent layout, visor shape, dark finish and straps from the photograph. The small existing light-colored wordmark stays subtle and unchanged; never invent lettering. It is a vented BICYCLE helmet, with NO transparent face shield, no motorcycle ear covers, no LED, no camera and no extra accessory. Do not invent safety certification, impact-test performance, weight, material grade, sizing or price.
Keep this same fictional adult presenter, clothes, room/location and lighting from the opening photograph. From frame zero the camera slides briskly 15 cm from left to right while rising 8 cm, revealing the existing top vents and dark mesh. Her supporting hand stays under the helmet; one index finger briefly indicates an existing vent from its outer edge without covering it. Only a small 10-degree product tilt, no deformation, no full spin. Keep the complete visor and shell inside the frame.
Brisk natural real-time human motion, visible movement from the very first frame and continuing with purpose. No ultra-slow-motion orbit. Frame the HELMET as the product, not an appliance. Preserve all vents, mesh, visor, shell and chin straps consistently. No invented rear view or 360 rotation. Anatomically plausible hands, no extra fingers, no helmet morphing or changing into another model. No scene cuts, montage, text, subtitles, watermark, music, sound effects or narration. Relaxed closed mouth, no talking or lip sync. Do not add a motorcycle face shield or accessory. Keep the full helmet visible throughout.
